characters.description: The Earth-born innkeeper of the Wandering Inn. She has made a home near Liscor and protects the varied people who gather there.
characters.name: Erin Solstice

characters.description: A young Gnoll who lives under the protection of Erin, Lionette, and the inn's wider household.
characters.name: Mrsha

characters.description: Liscor's Watch Captain, responsible for the imprisoned Minotaur.
characters.name: Zevara

characters.description: An imprisoned Minotaur commander held under Zevara's lawful authority in Liscor.
characters.name: Calruz

characters.description: An inventive necromancer and member of the Horns.
characters.name: Pisces

characters.description: The half-elf leader and ice mage of the Horns, an adventuring team based around Liscor.
characters.name: Ceria Springwalker

characters.description: An adventurer and member of the Horns.
characters.name: Yvlon

characters.description: The Antinium adventurer in the Horns.
characters.name: Ksmvr

characters.description: A Goblin survivor who lives at the Wandering Inn under Erin's protection.
characters.name: Numbtongue

characters.description: A manager of the Wandering Inn and one of Mrsha's guardians.
characters.name: Lionette

characters.description: A damaged, sentient skeleton confined to Liscor's mana-rich dungeon. Toren also moves through a masked female form and, burdened by abandoning Erin, has begun choosing to protect living beings.
characters.name: Toren

characters.description: A former-miner adventuring team led by Erlea. Its members recover valuable materials by dismantling inactive traps in Liscor's dungeon.
characters.name: Gemhammer

characters.description: Anith's silver-rank adventuring team. They guard Gemhammer's salvage work and regard the dungeon's masked warrior as a benefactor.
characters.name: Vuleil Dre

characters.description: The gold-rank Wings of Pallass are commanded by Bavusa. She questions the identity of a masked dungeon combatant, but relents when she understands the figure's behavior around a destroyed zombie as mourning.
characters.name: Bavusa

characters.description: An intelligent black skeleton created as one of a necromancer's Chosen. After a failed attack on Zel Shivertail, she waits for new orders and fears her creator has abandoned her.
characters.name: Black skeleton

characters.description: Liscor's strategist and the administrative guide for its newly seated council, helping the inexperienced body turn its proposed reforms into policy.
characters.name: Olesm

characters.description: An armorer chosen for Liscor's new Gnoll council. Her trade plan would send ore from Esselm to Pallass in return for metal goods and instruction for local smiths.
characters.name: Regrika

characters.description: A Liscor resident entrusted with the Heartflame armor.
characters.name: Selys

characters.description: An officer of Liscor's Watch.
characters.name: Relc

characters.description: The Wall Lord of Salazsar. He gave Erin a family ring protected by an enchantment that makes it easy to overlook, and he secretly shelters a surviving Pallasian captain.
characters.name: Ilvriss

characters.description: A military survivor and the niece of a dead Pallasian general. Ilvriss conceals her identity, presents her as his bodyguard, and entrusts her with organizing a covert force.
characters.name: Pallasian captain

characters.description: An undead former human archmage ruling a concealed castle west of the Bloodfields. He commands an army, specialized Chosen, and distant puppets, and has begun teaching Pisces through an undead rat.
characters.name: Hidden necromancer

characters.description: The ruler of a beast-taming empire under coalition invasion. She directs war elephants and other animal-supported defenders while the enemy closes around her capital.
characters.name: Empress of Beasts

characters.description: An unnamed correspondent whose unusually detailed accounts from the war front place the reporter at risk. A magic academy sends a team to find and recover the correspondent.
characters.name: Unnamed frontline reporter

characters.description: A distant monarch whose peace proclamation limits his response to the war against the Empress. With her capital surrounded, she asks him to decide her empire's fate.
characters.name: Flos

characters.description: The elected leader of a golem-state in the coalition. He remains at the front despite expecting a devastating final assault and prepares his command for the possibility of his death.
characters.name: Magus-crafter

characters.description: Commander of the defeated empire's remaining field army. During the surrender, the general leads soldiers and civilians north toward the Kaleel Steppes.
characters.name: Empress's general

characters.description: Germina's child ruler, carrying the memories and knowledge of earlier Quarasses despite the limited magic and strength of her present body. She allies with Flos to protect her country.
characters.name: Quarass of Germina

characters.description: An Earth-born envoy traveling on Flos's behalf. He explains his world's technology to the Quarass and accompanies her into negotiations with Kelt.
characters.name: Trey

characters.description: Kelt's ancient ruler and guardian. He withdraws his army while talks proceed, but demands lasting safeguards before aiding a conqueror whose reign he considers temporary.
characters.name: Kelt's undead king

characters.description: A smallfolk strategist, professor, and second-in-command of a great mercenary company. He uses live deceptions to test his advanced students and expects them to challenge authority as well as master logistics.
characters.name: Niers Astoragon

characters.description: A stealth specialist who leads Niers's mercenary company. She can pass unnoticed at close range and selectively remove memories.
characters.name: Head of Niers's company

characters.description: One of Niers's unconventional students, strong at tactical surprise but still developing the authority and appetite for risk needed for larger commands.
characters.name: Lizardfolk strategist student

characters.description: A strategist student with a gift for logistics and a direct approach to command. Family duty competes with his private wish to pursue a great discovery.
characters.name: Human lord student

characters.description: The leader of five Wistram mages and a former associate of Pisces and Ceria. She forcibly detains Pisces and the Horns without first consulting Liscor's Watch.
characters.name: Wistram team leader

characters.description: One of the five Wistram mages who participates in the team's unsanctioned seizure of Pisces and the Horns.
characters.name: Wistram team mage

characters.description: Pisces's full identity, revealed when he admits his common-born Terandrian upbringing and accepts responsibility for the fatal Wistram tomb theft. He refuses surrender, and the Horns reaffirm their loyalty to him.
characters.name: Pisces Jilnet
